rules.accepted_credit_types: Continuing nursing education meeting Chapter 4723-14 OAC; pharmacology hours from an accredited institution recognized by the Board. CE earned to obtain or maintain national certification counts if it meets Chapter 4723-14.
rules.new_licensee_rule: No CE required for the first renewal after the APRN license is first issued.
rules.alternatives: Up to 8 of the 24 hours may be earned by volunteer APRN care to indigent and uninsured persons (1 hour per 60 minutes, documented). The RN one-time CE waiver does not apply to APRN hours.

topics.who: CNPs, CNMs and CNSs (not CRNAs): advanced pharmacology, part of the 24 APRN hours

rules.notes: The 24 hours for each APRN license are in addition to the 24 hours (incl. 1 h Category A) for the Ohio RN license.
